description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.04.2015 to 19.04.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), specifically establishing new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes new regulatory requirements for customs payments, falling squarely within the Legal/Regulatory category for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
